<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def redinfo(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (n['pixels'],min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def ppos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and 20<=n['pixels']<=30:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (round((min(rows)+max(rows))/2), round((min(cols)+max(cols))/2))
    return None
for i in range(6):
    print('t',i,'red',redinfo(current_frame),'player',ppos(current_frame),'step',current_frame.step)
    action(['RIGHT'])  # blocked no-op at (34,16)
print('after', 'red',redinfo(current_frame),'player',ppos(current_frame),'step',current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
